race.comment: ENDLESS SUMMER (1) should take some beating. He was first up off a short break at Ballarat Synthetic and ran a good race when missing a long neck behind Salizou who has since won in better company at Flemington. He should be fitter for that now and finds a winnable race. CRYPT (3) broke through for a narrow maiden win last time out at Bendigo after making up good ground from a wide gate. He's still lightly raced and can repeat the dose. DURHAM LEGACY (10) presents third up and should set up nicely on speed, he can run a new peak here and that's good enough to figure. IS THAT ALL (2) wasn't beaten far fresh at Sale and has claims with improvement.
